title: Open to Full-Time Opportunities Starting Summer 2027
summary: As I enter the final phase of my Ph.D. at Penn State, I am actively looking ahead to full-time R&D roles starting Summer 2027 in Computational Materials Science, MLIP / AI-for-Science Engineering, and Clean Energy Electrocatalysis.

title: Comprehensive Electrocatalyst Design Review Published in Small
summary: Excited to share our comprehensive first-author review in Small examining rational electronic-structure, strain, defect, and computational design strategies toward efficient and durable green hydrogen water electrolysis.

title: Fine-Tuning OC25 eSEN & Magnetic MACE/mMACE + Multi-MLIP Surface Screening
summary: Built automated multi-GPU pipelines for spin-polarized MLIP fine-tuning, explicit microsolvation convergence, multi-model committee uncertainty (sigma) active learning, and automated VASP DFT validation workflows on A100 clusters.

title: Metal-Center Redox Mechanisms for AEM Water Electrolyzers in Advanced Energy Materials
summary: Our collaborative study published in Advanced Energy Materials uncovers how multi-metal coordination centers in FeMn(NbTa)2O6 columbite oxides mediate intermediate adsorption and redox stability in anion exchange membrane water electrolyzers.

title: New Insights into Heterostructured Electrocatalysts & TiO2/FeS2 Photocatalysts
summary: Published two collaborative DFT-driven investigations in Journal of Colloid and Interface Science and Physical Chemistry Chemical Physics explaining interfacial charge transfer and active-site synergy in earth-abundant and hybrid water-splitting systems.
